svg.title: thought-typed-token-staircase-grid-with-snapshot
svg.desc: a lower-triangular grid of small square cells, one row per generated token, each cell carrying a letter R, E or T for its thought type; blue cells are kept, a green cell marks the current token on the diagonal, grey X cells are evicted, an orange outline groups a block of cells, a dashed vertical line marks the prefill boundary, and a row of hatched cells below shows the cache snapshot | source: iclr26-0125_fig1 (iclr26-0125_fig1_p1_mixed.svg) | candidate wave3:thought-typed-token-staircase-grid-with-snapshot | units: pt at print size | colours as drawn, recolour by role
